item.title: Show HN: Analytics Tycoon: I built an Age of Empires like game for data
item.summary: Day 1. You're the new Head of Data and you inherit a stack nobody has touched in years, along with a single database administrator. Can you advance through the ages of data, from 'typewriter' through 'modern data stack' to 'agentic analytics' and beyond? Can you do it whilst keeping an eye on your opex? Can you bring the company to IPO within 155 days, before the board give up? This weekend, I built Analytics Tycoon. Your very own chance to build out the data stack of your dreams, with an age of empires like tech tree and some nice surprises :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49154526 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
